title: Abaqus workflows and connector status
description: Explore Abaqus workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Dassault Systèmes

Abaqus

Abaqus supports advanced finite-element analysis for nonlinear, contact and multiphysics problems.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Build a nonlinear model

Start from the idealised geometry, material assumptions and analysis scope. In the intended Abaqus preview, build a nonlinear model; the visible result is a solver-ready model view with mesh regions and constraints exposed. Review units, connectivity, mesh suitability and model assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Define contact and load steps

Begin with the selected load cases, contacts and solution controls. In the intended Abaqus preview, define contact and load steps; the visible result is a configured analysis state with loads and boundary conditions visible. Review load paths, restraints, convergence controls and applicable codes before accepting or exporting it.

Interpret response and failure

Use the completed result set and acceptance quantities. In the intended Abaqus preview, interpret response and failure; the visible result is plots or tables that connect response values to the model. Review convergence, sensitivity, units and engineering reasonableness before accepting or exporting it.
